question: Objects move with a constant speed when no _______ is acting on it.
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e __**Force,**__

__**CONCEPT**__:

__
 
• **Force (F)**: The interaction which after applying on body changes or try to change the state of motion or state of rest is called force.

Force (F) = Mass (m) × Acceleration (a)

 
• **Speed (v)**: The rate of change of distance is called speed.
 
• **Acceleration (a)**: The rate of change of velocity is called acceleration.

**EXPLANATION**__:

When force (F) = 0

Acceleraion (a) = F/m = 0/m = 0

__
 
• Since there is **no acceleration**, so there will be **no change in speed.** Hence the **speed will remain constant**.
 
• Objects **move at a constant speed when no force **is acting on it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• This was **first** declared by** Galileo Galilei**.
 
• It means **that an object will continue to be in motion when no other force is acting upon it while it is moving on a frictionless path**.
